title: sentilab-open-publish/1
description: The participant's explicit, logged choice to publish a private entry (DESIGN rev 3 section 5.6): it names the proposal_sha256, comes from the same account, under accepted terms. It is posted in plaintext, so it discloses that proposal_sha256 to the room. A proposal_sha256 that is not one of the account's own earlier proposals in this manifest is unknown_proposal.
